reason: I sit up every night writing bills and AMC dates for 30-odd technicians, so ₹4,499 is nothing next to my time. With the first month free and pay-only-if-they-use-it, I lose nothing by letting the founder set it up and watching whether my boys actually press the button.
objection: One founder and ten shops. Who is this man, and if he gets sick or shuts down in a year, my whole team's habit and my AMC follow-ups go with him. Also my senior technicians will not change how they work just because I say so.
would_change_my_mind: If at the end of the free month fewer than half my technicians are using it, or if I cannot meet the founder and see a couple of other Chennai shops already running it, I walk away.
